user.title: Connect to GoXLR Utility
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the PC running the GoXLR Utility. In the Utility, network access must be enabled so it listens on more than localhost.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the GoXLR Utility. Check the address, that the Utility is running, and that network access is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This GoXLR Utility is already configured
